name: Objectives, Tasks, Scheduling, and Execution
purpose: Define the authoritative Task/Objectives model for scheduling, overlap grouping, execution, review, correction, retries, historical proposals, and cross-domain consequences without conflating source plans, operational plans, Objective envelopes or actual execution.

decisions.decision: Task is the independent scheduling/execution attempt; Objective is the Maintenance Window aggregate that groups zero-or-more draft candidates but persists only with at least one Task.
A Task may remain unscheduled or belong to at most one persisted Objective; Objective membership requires a valid accepted Task interval.
WFM source plan, accepted operational Task plan, derived Objective envelope and actual execution are separate authorities.
The Objective envelope is derived as min accepted member-plan start and max accepted member-plan end; it does not overwrite member Task plans after initialization.
Automatic grouping computes global transitive connected components of strict positive-duration overlap. Customer and RFC context explain partitions/warnings but do not create temporal boundaries.
Grouping/regrouping is a reviewable non-authoritative proposal. Accepted Objectives may not overlap; bridging work proposes consolidation rather than creating overlap.
Objective start never implicitly starts member Tasks. Task execution, cancellation and reviewed outcome are independently recorded per Task.
Objective aggregate state/outcome is derived from member Task facts. Whole-Objective Cancelled is valid only when no Task began execution; mixed Task outcomes remain mixed.
Review acceptance time is separate from execution chronology; correction changes prior recorded interpretation through append-only history, while retry creates a new Task attempt identity.
Plan/membership locks derive from accepted execution/history/explicit lock, not wall-clock passage.
Distinct WFM Task Nos are distinct attempts. Competing-attempt restriction applies only to overlapping active attempts of the same reviewed activity lineage.
Provider Complete plus valid source plan may propose historical Objective structure, but never fabricates execution, Task outcome, Device work, spare use or Inventory consequence.
Objective scheduling timezone is an IANA presentation/input context only; persisted known instants remain canonical UTC and other-domain chronology is unaffected.
Once Objective/Task accepted execution or protected history exists, hard deletion is permanently unavailable; only an unaccepted UI draft may be discarded.

unresolved_here_by_design: O-003 exact detailed Task outcome transition/correction reason vocabulary beyond accepted outcomes
exact Objective tracking-ID serialization and monthly ordinal presentation format
exact interval-component implementation/data structure and scaling thresholds
exact regroup proposal persistence schema and rejection-fingerprint representation
exact historical operational-count inclusion controls and UI placement
